implementation: Generic and specialized candidate generators accept an optional gate callback. Candidates remain deterministic and ordered; generation stops only when the callback accepts the current candidate. CandidateFeasibilityCompiler uses the existing hard gates as that callback.
semantic_invariants: Candidate bytes, IDs, seeds, and order are unchanged.
The existing GateRegistry remains the sole acceptance authority.
The historically selected result was passing[0]; the streaming implementation stops at that same first passing candidate.
If no candidate passes, the generator exhausts the same original sequence and reports the same accumulated failed checks.
No research threshold, topology rule, area budget, or patient rule changes.
explicit_sequence_test: The first three streamed candidates are byte-identical to the first three full candidates; an always-false callback produces the full byte-identical sequence.
